tool_args.rationale: The slow-horizon probe reveals the predicted reversal and supplies three long-horizon observations. Fit all five parameters numerically and test the resulting mechanism on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Eight observations now cover both short and long horizons; the archived five-parameter adaptation law can be fitted without another trajectory batch.
The observed long-horizon sign reversal and archived sink-coupled dual-horizon mechanism directly motivate the simpler adaptation law.

considered_alternatives.option: static siphon and sink-free dual-horizon models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Static siphon cannot explain horizon-dependent reversal, while the sink-free model omits the observed gradient dependence.
